notes.title: The BIGGEST Update So Far !
notes.notes:
This is the biggest update Destroy Them has received.

There are a ton of patches for a lot of bugs, a new user interface, new menus and more !

The new menu : {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/34d139c424a4108b39ca1166d8d5a7b1f440315a.png

The new HUD : {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/0ec21cdfec8dbe008d5c75b2a9c4d18aedca9fb0.png

All the fixes : 
-Improved menus
-Now show remaining bullet like this: 24/40 instead of 24/Infinite
-New logo for the game
-Replaced some texts "like press E to dash" by icons (UI improvement)
-Improved footsteps noise
-Blackened the vignetting effect when taking damage
-Added a sound when you die and improved the "dying" interface
-The robots always follow you now, they will not stop if you jump too high anymore

[previewyoutube=TpnZKs9b7S8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Discover the new major update of Destroy Them !
notes.notes:
With this New Update, you'll be able to play with a new exciting weapon : the submachine gun !
You can now switch guns during the game and you can use the other weapon when one is empty ! 
There is also a new hidden map for you to discover, bringing the total amount of maps to 5 !
[previewyoutube=uPwKVXww6Os;full][/previewyoutube]
If you have any feedback to give, don't hesitate, I'm open to any suggestions :-)
